blocks.title: Kimiyai bandhan (chemical bond)
blocks.text: Kimiyai bandhan (chemical bond) woh quwwat hai jo do ya zyada atoms, molecules ya ions ko ek saath rakhti hai. Kisi madde ki khusoosiyat us ke atoms ke darmiyan kimiyai bandhan ki qism par munhasir hain.

Chemical bond ki istilah (term) mein ionic, covalent, dative aur metallic bonds ke saath saath bain-al-molecular (intermolecular) quwwatein, yani van der Waals forces, bhi shamil hain; kamzor hone ki wajah se van der Waals forces ko aam taur par khalis kimiyai bandhan nahi kaha jata. Yeh chapter bonds ki qismein electronegativity aur bonding ki nau'iyat, dipole moment aur polarity par us ke asar ki roshni mein bayan karta hai; phir jadeed bonding theories, VSEPR, VBT, hybridization aur MOT; phir intermolecular forces; aur aakhir mein bond energies ke lihaz se kimiyai bonds aur intermolecular forces ka muqabla. Sodium chloride mein ionic bond hai aur woh thos hai, jabke pani covalent compound hai aur maya (liquid).

Bonding ka Lewis tasawwur har qism ke bond ke banne ki sada wazahat deta hai. Is nazariye ke mutabiq atoms apne sab se bahar wale shells mukammal karne ke liye bonds banate hain taake un ki configuration noble gas jaisi ho jaye, jo zyada tar valence shell mein octet (aath electrons) bana kar hasil hoti hai.

blocks.alt: Oopar ki qatar: sodium ek electron chlorine ko deta hai, do chlorine atoms ek jora baantte hain, aur H3O+, CO aur O3 ke dative bonds par notes. Neeche ki qatar: sulfate ion ki Lewis structure do double aur do single bonds ke saath, sulfur ke 3s 3p 3d khane ek electron ke 3d mein jane se pehle aur baad, aur tri-iodide ion jis ke darmiyani iodine par teen lone pairs hain.
blocks.caption: Lewis tasawwur se ionic, covalent aur dative bonds, aur sulfate aur tri-iodide mein phaile hue (expanded) octets (Figures 3.1 se 3.3 aur chhapi hui Lewis structures ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Sodium, kam ionization energy ke saath, apna akela bairooni electron chlorine ko deta hai, jis ki electron affinity zyada hai; phir Na+ aur Cl- ions ek doosre ko khinchte hain. Do chlorine atoms, barabar electronegativity ke, ek jora baantte hain aur har ek aath ginta hai. Dative bond mein ek atom dono electrons deta hai: H3O+ mein oxygen ka lone pair proton ko, CO mein oxygen ka lone pair carbon ko, aur ozone mein darmiyani oxygen ka jora teesri oxygen ko. Sulfate ion mein sulfur ke baarah valence electrons hain, octet se chaar zyada, kyunke ek 3p electron khali 3d orbital mein ja sakta hai; I3- ke darmiyani iodine ke das hain. Period 2 ke atoms ke paas d orbitals nahi, to woh phaila nahi sakte.

blocks.prompt: Lewis tasawwur ek jumle mein batayein, aur kimiyai bond ki chaar qismein aur woh kamzor quwwat batayein jo chapter mein shamil hai.
blocks.explanation: Atoms apna bairooni shell mukammal karne, aam taur par octet tak, aur yun noble gas configuration pane ke liye bond banate hain. Bonds ionic, covalent, dative aur metallic hain; kamzor quwwat van der Waals (intermolecular) force hai.

items: Kimiyai bond atoms, molecules ya ions ko jorta hai; ionic, covalent, dative aur metallic bonds asli bonds hain, van der Waals forces kamzor intermolecular quwwatein.
Lewis tasawwur: atoms apna sab se bairooni shell (octet) mukammal kar ke noble gas configuration pane ke liye bond banate hain.
